name: Interactive Quiz Widget
description: Build a single-file interactive quiz or assessment — multiple-choice, true/false, or a scored personality quiz — that asks questions one at a time, tracks the score, gives feedback, and shows a results screen. Authors the question bank, answer keys, and scoring logic first, designs the question and results UI, then implements stateful question flow with correct scoring. Quizzes break when the score is miscounted or the results screen never appears, so the content phase locks the answer key and the score-to-result mapping before any markup.
